milestones.title: 0.75.0 — reliability & enforcement
milestones.summary: The owner's four verbatim asks shipped together: the transient-API retry ladder (immediate → 1.5m → 5m → 10m → 30m → stop+notify, visible status card), hard task-mode enforcement (plan/review/explore read-only at the toolset level, owner-pinned, debug command tier, delegation inheritance), hover-only mode descriptions + read-only badges, and the single-row composer toolbar with the actually-working 5-line textarea. The deepest find: SDK error PARTS were swallowed — real 429s could never classify nor ladder; the adapter now re-throws them (live-verified).

milestones.title: R76 — the documentation round
milestones.summary: Docs caught up with the code: the session history backfilled R68-R75 (8 entries, +147 lines), five AGENT-MEMORY lessons recorded (72-76), the two R75 ADRs written (0026 task-mode policy, 0027 retry-ladder), ARCHITECTURE/IMPLEMENTED-API/EXTENSIBILITY/DESIGN-SYSTEM/ROADMAP/SECURITY/HANDOFF corrected to the shipped truth, the docs index completed (5 unindexed runbooks), and the stamp-cohort rule documented where the next agent will find it (DOC-STANDARDS §8 + MAINTENANCE recipe g). Docs-only: 0.75.0 unchanged, no release.

milestones.title: R77 — the field-report round
milestones.summary: The 0.75.0 field report addressed end-to-end: the composer split left/right with the send action locked to its cluster, the model pill's Cpu icon, the redesigned retry card, the vanish-on-failure fix (freezeFailedTurn keeps the error card + the user's message), envelope-intact API errors + full-text error cards, revert-as-edit-and-resend (inclusive truncation + composer refill), and a live real-provider E2E battery including a genuine rate-limit storm that exercised the retry ladder live.

milestones.title: R78 — the honest-errors + queue round
milestones.summary: The owner’s four verbatim asks shipped together: the error chain robustified (RetryError unwrapped so classification reads the real status; a 403 region block no longer lies ‘authentication failed’; userMessage is the API’s REAL text — only a real rate limit ladders, every other failure shows the provider’s actual words on the live retry card too), the composer’s action group restructured into a never-wrapping bottom-right anchor (Continue/Send/Stop/queue-send can never render in a wrong position), the Settings → General retry config (three per-class auto-retry switches — a disabled class fails fast with the real text), and the message queue (send while the agent works — the message queues as an amber chip, auto-delivers after the current tool call with full context, continues the same stream at turn end, survives stops/crashes via the pre-flip). Verified: 2708 tests (agent-core 1742), the battery-r78 live battery 12/12 (real 429 ladder + a mock-provider request-body oracle), browser-verified on the real dev stack.

milestones.title: R79 — the orchestrator round
milestones.summary: The standing R73 deferral shipped — addressable, background, resumable sub-agent tasks (the last unshipped piece of the R71 sub-agent discipline): delegate_task gained task_id (the parent model’s own address, grammar-checked, duplicate-refused, capped at 10 outstanding background tasks), background:true (fire-and-forget with an immediate receipt while the child runs detached — it outlives the parent’s turn, streams to the Sub-agents panel, and its status rides the next turn’s system prompt as the per-turn BACKGROUND TASKS section that disappears once collected), and resume (waits while the task runs, returns the final report idempotently, retries a failed child from where it stopped; the delegation.collected event on the parent’s log is the one delivery marker). The owner sees the address as a mono task-id chip in the panel + the chat card; migration 0028 (sessions.delegate_task_id). Verified: 2741 tests (agent-core 1769 incl. 27 new), the battery-r79 live battery 10/10 with the request-body oracle proving the model SEES the reminder section and its disappearance after collection.

milestones.title: R80 — the reliability round
milestones.summary: The owner's four-clause field report shipped as one round: the silent chat terminations fixed at three root causes (the SSE clean-close truncation guard — a provider dropping the stream mid-generation now throws the honest 'connection closed mid-response' error and the retry ladder engages; the context/request guard stops now persist real turn.errors with CONTEXT_LIMIT/REQUEST_LIMIT codes instead of ending ok:true; a route crash now persists and notifies instead of vanishing on reload), the raw error messages shown (every error-detail cap raised — 4000/600/2000 — with key scrubbing unchanged and the nvapi- prefix joined), the retry ladder made customizable (maxAttempts, per-rung waitMinutes, providerTimeoutSeconds — validated, resolved defensively per turn, edited from the Settings General card, the defaults byte-identical to the R75 behavior), and the NVIDIA NIM provider supported (seeded, key-wired through the env injection + dev key file, live-verified reachable + catalog + key auth). Verified 2772/2772 in 149 files + live on the real keys (a real OpenRouter streamed turn end-to-end, the retry PUT round-trips, the NVIDIA connection test).

milestones.title: R81 — the unified operating modes
milestones.summary: ONE picker of THREE modes (Full Access / Ask / Plan) replaces the task-mode picker + access-level switcher (ADR-0029). Postures became agent self-selection via switch_mode; enforcement lives solely in the operating mode (PLAN grew to the 19-tool read-only set); 'editor' retired fail-closed (migration 0029 preserves every historical guarantee). TaskModePicker/`/mode` deleted from the UI; live battery + browser + VLM verified.

milestones.title: R82 — models & providers hardening
milestones.summary: The owner's field report round 2: custom-provider model ROUTING fixed end-to-end (providerId rides the send wire, the vision relay, the context meter, queued messages, sub-agent children — a model picked under a custom gateway or NVIDIA serves there, with restart-surviving keys via the Rust note-file), the per-model TEST button (a real completion probe with http/auth/model/content checks + scrubbed preview/reason), tri-state capability columns (migration 0030: null=unknown, never the 0004 false-lie), the capabilities edit-dialog card, provider-scoped subagentModel {providerId, modelId} (NIM rows pickable), GET /models/configured, and the NVIDIA picker polish (dialog-local free-scope, zero-free auto-switch). Live battery 8/8 on the real keys (custom gateway routing through a mock oracle with its own key, real OpenRouter + NIM probes, hostile key-echo scrubbed).

milestones.title: R83 — honest token & context metering
milestones.summary: The owner's 'highly misleading' round: ONE budget (resolveTurnBudget — window WITH source label, the owner's max_output_tokens finally honored, available = window − output − margin) drives the meter, the compaction trigger, and the context guard; the donut shows the provider's OWN number for the last request (actual block from the stats carriers) beside the labeled ~projected estimate, applies the newest compaction (the ring drops instead of lying high), renders the budget tick + window provenance; schema-measured tool tokens replace the 350/tool guess; the meter's prompt sections match the real turn's (skills/task-modes/active-mode/background/environment); migration 0031's provider_calls + origin make 'N turns · M provider calls' honest and the hidden compaction/debug calls billed; cached-null hit rates ('— not reported'), (unpriced) cost markers, the real POST /sessions/:id/compact (the 800K guard's phantom /compact finally exists), the model-relative guard with honest numbers. Live battery 5/5 on real keys (actual=61 tokens measured end-to-end).

milestones.title: R84 — the modularity round (Wave 2: the SCC break + the server.ts route split)
milestones.summary: Wave 2 of the R80.5 audit, behavior-identical and test-guarded: the 25-file agents↔tools SCC is DEAD (the delegation plugin's static orchestrator import — the root cause — replaced by the agents/sub-roles.ts leaf + the ToolDeps.orchestrator seam + a lazy fallback; a Tarjan check over the runtime import graph reports zero cycles), and server.ts shrank 5,719 → 2,439 lines (−57%) as 71 routes moved verbatim into 14 routes/<domain>.ts modules (sessions, agents, projects, models, providers, attachments, memory, skills, modes, ratings, usage, settings) on the proven registerBrowserRoutes pattern with buildServer as the assembler — each phase a separate green commit. The remaining domains (terminal, MCP, computer-use, diagnostics, approvals, the SSE route) are the documented next phases.

milestones.title: R85 — the structure re-assessment
milestones.summary: The owner-directed post-R84 audit, docs-only: three parallel analysis sweeps re-verified at c38bc8b — R84's wins CONFIRMED (the SCC dead, server.ts 5,719→2,439 exact) with three overstatements corrected (one benign 2-cycle remains: registry↔plugins/mcp TOOL_NAME_RE since R61; 52 routes remain in server.ts, not ~31 — the notifications/jobs/checkpoints/dialogs/plugins tail was never on the plan; the SSE route is 476 lines); the turn-loop duplication measured (378 byte-identical lines; runtime.ts grew to 3,369; prepareTurn 447 lines/10 positional args); the frontend god files all grew since R80.5 (api 3,959 / stream-store 1,936 / ModelsProvidersTab 3,304; 559 lines of dead sessions/ code; zero extension seams); SQL leaks counted at 22 (approvals.ts ×11); every P0 doc drift fixed (MODULE-BOUNDARIES rewritten to the post-R84 reality, MAINTENANCE §e, HANDOFF, round-84.md backfilled, the board/index/TESTING/IMPLEMENTED-API/ROADMAP/EXTENSIBILITY synced, WORKLOG R76-R81 backfill, lessons #84-#85). v0.83.0 unchanged.

milestones.summary: The owner's task-list session: (1) the R85 claims re-verified with three parallel sweeps — backend exact (52-route inventory, 22 SQL leaks, the 2-cycle, the 378-line duplication, ToolDeps missing runId), four frontend numbers corrected (api.ts 85 importers not 72; ModelsProvidersTab 60 hooks/3 dialogs; 14 stores; StreamTurnEvent 37 members), the dead sessions/ dir caught receiving an R83 edit, three narrow frontend seams the 'zero' claim missed. (2) THE SSE ROUTE EXTRACTED — routes/sse.ts (the final-phase domain of the R84 split): the 476-line streamed turn route moved verbatim (byte-identical round-trip verifier), server.ts 2,439→1,913, eleven single-consumer imports pruned, registration order preserved; full pipeline green (2,825 tests byte-identical to baseline, e2e 12/12 on the built dist, live boot smoke). v0.84.0. (3) Ops: six stale branches deleted (only main remains — the r61 branch's superseded cua-helper line documented with recoverable tips), the stuck v0.83.0 DRAFT release PUBLISHED (both assets verified), the DASHBOARD's stale plan section truth-synced.

milestones.title: R87 — the UX + capability round (About/reset, configure-before-add, ask_user, the embedded browser)
milestones.summary: The owner's improvement list, delivered as v0.85.0: (1) Settings → About — the version card with the update check + the application-wide RESET (POST /system/reset: live-turn abort, keyring clear, terminal dispose, table wipe + factory reseed, VACUUM, ~/.acute purge; the Tauri purge_provider_keys command clears Credential Manager first). (2) credentials.txt REMOVED from the launcher (the GitHub token is asked once + saved at .acute/github.pat or ACUTE_GITHUB_PAT; provider keys are saved in-app only). (3) ask_user end-to-end — the mid-task question card (option pills + custom answer, batched questions, 10-min timeout) with agent-question.requested/resolved session events + the resolve route; migration 0033. (4) The todo list VISIBLE in chat (TodoCard in the working stream, live via todo-updated frames). (5) Models & Providers redesigned: bordered model cards + capability chips (migration 0032: PDF input + text/image/video/audio outputs + sizeLabel; reasoning + tool use REMOVED from the dialog — the app detects them), configure-before-add (the picker opens the config dialog instead of adding directly), the animated self-dismissing test button, the NVIDIA phantom-add fixed (hasKey-aware existingIds). (6) The embedded browser: default viewport 1440×900, KEEP-ALIVE browser panels (no reload/glitch on tab switch, survives the new-tab menu with a deliberate pause hint), read_dom now returns per-element x/y/w/h positions, screenshots are panel-only (the full-display fallback is GONE). (7) The chat/shell batch: viewport-adaptive scrollbars, the chat min width halved + wide padding, the composer's graduated shrink (model name first), the provider-selector trajectory gating + frosted-glass backdrop, the sidebar rail expanding on project click.
